selection_rules: For a request to install on this device (本机/安装到本机), identify the user target device from their explicit statement, trusted device context, or tools confirmed to run on that device. Never infer the user device from an AI cloud, server, or container OS. If unknown, ask whether the target is a phone/tablet or a Windows/Mac computer. Mobile targets use mobile_download even when agent tools run on a desktop. For desktop targets, download the matching installer. When the user asks to install on Windows and tools run on that target device, use the selected record install.silent_arguments for silent installation; download-only requests do not run an installer. For a Mac installation request on the user target device, use the selected record install metadata: mount the DMG, copy the app bundle into Applications, and detach the mounted image. Download-only requests do not install or launch apps.

For mobile, phone, tablet, Android, or iOS requests, return mobile_download.url and mobile_download.message. Do not download an APK or enter the desktop file-selection flow. A generic mobile request does not require asking Android versus iOS; a requested mobile version is not a guarantee of availability on the official page.

For desktop requests, match windows or macos first. Ask whether the target is mobile or desktop if the device is missing. The phrase computer/desktop version alone is ambiguous between Windows and macOS; ask which system. The files array preserves archived package metadata, including Android; it does not override mobile_download.
For a requested version, match within the same operating system. Match Windows file_version when a four-component build is requested.
If no version is specified, resolve latest_by_platform for that operating system. Never compare version numbers across platforms or use the repository-wide releases/latest endpoint.
Download the chosen record download_url directly. No file-size or SHA-256 verification step is required. Do not substitute another platform or invent an unavailable version.

Report a download only after the download tool reports completion. If the user target device cannot be reached, return the direct link and, for Windows installation requests, the silent installation command without claiming that download or installation happened there. For Windows installation requests, use install.silent_arguments (case-sensitive /S for this NSIS package), request administrator elevation when required, and wait for the installer to finish. Report its actual outcome; a started process or completed download is not a completed installation. If silent-install metadata is absent, do not guess arguments. Never run installers for download-only requests. For Mac installation requests, use install.type=dmg_app_copy, check minimum_macos, mount read-only without opening Finder, copy app_bundle to destination (or fallback_destination if unwritable), then detach the image and report the actual installed path. Reuse an existing app only when bundle_identifier and both bundle versions match; otherwise back up the old bundle before replacing it, restore it if copying fails, and do not overwrite a different app. Preserve macOS security attributes. Do not claim success if installation failed or the target device cannot be reached. Expand ~ in fallback_destination to the target user home directory before passing the resulting absolute path to shell commands.
Unknown architecture and OS compatibility must remain unknown; do not promise compatibility.

mobile_download.message: 请在手机或平板浏览器中打开人人视频官网下载页 https://rrsp.app/，按照页面提示下载并安装。
mobile_download.note: Mobile requests, including an unspecified mobile platform or a requested mobile version, return this page instead of downloading a repository APK. Available versions and installation methods depend on the official page; do not claim a requested version is available or that download or installation has completed.
